    2. The crescent will cease to exist when its interest rate reaches the value of the interest rate of the currency.

    6. Monetizing the crescent does not alter its value or purchasing power. It only changes the rate at which it is retired. Instead of being retired at 5%, the crescent will be retired at a rate of 5.5%.
